tokens.name: cherry-cola
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. All text and numbers on light surfaces: 5.4:1 on hibiscus-tonic, 10.3:1 on oat-milk, 11:1 on white. Outlines the mascot.

tokens.name: cherry-900
tokens.usage: Deepest ink. The hard block shadow under primary buttons, the kettlebell handle, the bezel in presentations. Never a full-screen background.

tokens.name: maraschino
tokens.usage: The bright red accent. The one main action per screen, personal-best markers, celebration moments. Text on it is white only (4.9:1). Never set text in maraschino on hibiscus-tonic (2.4:1).

tokens.name: hibiscus-tonic
tokens.usage: Primary surface: celebration screens, cards on oat-milk, highlights. Text on it is cherry-cola only; ink-muted fails here.

tokens.name: hibiscus-50
tokens.usage: Quiet tint. Chart area fills, selected rows, the mascot's shine pixels.

tokens.name: oat-milk
tokens.usage: Warm off-white for logging screens and trainer workspace backgrounds, so numbers stay readable mid-set.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards on oat-milk and text on maraschino buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on oat-milk (6.1:1) and white (6.6:1). Fails on hibiscus-tonic (3.2:1): use cherry-cola there.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders on oat-milk and white.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default text.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting lines, chart labels, timestamps on oat-milk or white.

tokens.name: surface-log
tokens.usage: Background of every screen where people type or tap numbers.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Background of client celebration screens.

tokens.name: surface-card

tokens.usage: Main action fill. One per screen.
